
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(here)
library(Seurat)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(scplotter)

set.seed(1)

i_am("code/14_glb1_endothelial_analysis.qmd")

walk(file.path("code/r_utils",
               c("import_h5ad.R", "project_helpers.R", "plotting_helpers.R")),
     source)

paths <- make_paths("14_glb1_endothelial_analysis", data = list(
  mouse_data = here("data", "processed", "02_endothelial.h5ad")
))
```


```{r}
mm_seurat <- h5ad_to_seurat(paths$data$mouse_data)

beta_gal <- FetchData(mm_seurat, vars = "Glb1", layer = "counts")[, 1]
mm_seurat$glb1_expr <- ifelse(beta_gal > 0, "Glb1+", "Glb1-")

glb1_expr_data <- FetchData(mm_seurat, vars = "Glb1", layer = "counts") |>
  mutate(threshold = ifelse(Glb1 > 0, "above", "below"))

p1 <- ggplot(glb1_expr_data, aes(x = Glb1, fill = threshold)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("above" = "#2b00ff",
                               "below" = "#7a7a7a")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 5)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Glb1 expression (counts)", y = "Number of cells") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9))

ggsave(file.path(paths$out$figures, "endo_glb1_expr_barplot.svg"), p1, width = 6, height = 4)

glb1_data <- tibble(
  genotype = mm_seurat$genotype,
  celltype = mm_seurat$celltype,
  glb1_expr = mm_seurat$glb1_expr,
  sample = mm_seurat$sample_id,
  sex = mm_seurat$sex) |>
  group_by(genotype, celltype, sample, sex) |>
  summarise(glb1_pos = mean(glb1_expr == "Glb1+"), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "celltype", values_from = "glb1_pos")

write.csv(glb1_data, file.path(paths$out$tables, "glb1_expr_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
developmental_senescence_2025 <- c(
  "Cdkn1a", "Cdkn2b", "Cdkn1b",
  "Tgfb1", "Foxo3", "Foxo1", "Glb1"
)

msig_angiogenesis <- c(
  "Apoh", "App", "Ccnd2", "Col3a1", "Col5a2", "Cxcl5", "Fgfr1", "Fstl1", "Itgav", "Jag1",
  "Jag2", "Kcnj8", "Lpl", "Lrpap1", "Lum", "Msx1", "Nrp1", "Olr1", "Pdgfa", "Pf4",
  "Pglyrp1", "Postn", "Prg2", "Ptk2", "S100a4", "Serpina5", "Slco2a1", "Spp1", "Stc1",
  "Thbd", "Timp1", "Tnfrsf21", "Vav2", "Vcan", "Vegfa", "Vtn"
)

go_angiogenesis <- go_symbols("GO:0001525")

go_sprouting <- go_symbols("GO:0002040")

gene_sets <- list(
  "developmental_senescence_2025" = developmental_senescence_2025,
  "go_angiogenesis" = go_angiogenesis,
  "go_sprouting" = go_sprouting,
  "msig_angiogenesis" = msig_angiogenesis
)

mm_seurat <- AddModuleScore(mm_seurat,
  features = gene_sets,
  name = "module")

mm_seurat$genotype <- factor(mm_seurat$genotype, levels = c("WT", "KO"))

score_cols <- paste0("module", seq_along(gene_sets))
colnames(mm_seurat@meta.data)[match(score_cols, colnames(mm_seurat@meta.data))] <- names(gene_sets)

agg_mod_scores <- mm_seurat@meta.data |>
  filter(celltype %in% c("gen_cap", "prolif gen_cap", "arterial", "aerocytes")) |>
  group_by(celltype, genotype, sample_id, sex) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(names(gene_sets)), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(agg_mod_scores, file.path(paths$out$tables, "aggregate_module_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (name in names(gene_sets)) {
  p <- FeatureStatPlot(mm_seurat,
    features = name,
    plot_type = "dim",
    facet_by = "genotype",
    order = "high-top",
    upper_quantile = 0.95,
    palette = "Spectral",
    bg_cutoff = NULL,
    bg_color = NA,
    theme = "theme_void",
    legend.position = "right"
  ) &
    theme(plot.title = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_blank())

  ggsave(file.path(paths$out$figures, paste0(name, "_featureplot.tiff")),
         p, dpi = 600, width = 14, height = 6)

  pb_data <- list()

  for (ct in unique(mm_seurat$celltype)) {
    pb <- mm_seurat@meta.data |>
      filter(celltype == ct) |>
      group_by(sample_id, genotype, glb1_expr, sex) |>
      summarise(score = mean(.data[[name]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    pb_data[[ct]] <- pb
  }

  bind_rows(pb_data, .id = "celltype") |>
    group_split(celltype) |>
    walk(\(d) {
      d |>
        mutate(X = if_else(glb1_expr == "Glb1+", 1, 2),
               col = paste(genotype, sample_id, sep = "_")) |>
        dplyr::select(X, col, score) |>
        pivot_wider(names_from = "col", values_from = "score") |>
        arrange(X) |>
        write.csv(file.path(paths$out$tables,
                            paste0(name, "_",
                                   gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", d$celltype[1]),
                                   "_module_score.csv")),
                  row.names = FALSE)
    })
}
```

```{r}
pb_all <- mm_seurat@meta.data |>
  filter(celltype %in% c("gen_cap", "prolif gen_cap", "arterial", "aerocytes")) |>
  group_by(celltype, sample_id, genotype, glb1_expr) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(names(gene_sets)), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(names(gene_sets)), names_to = "module", values_to = "score")

pb_wider <- pb_all |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(celltype, module, sample_id, genotype),
              names_from = "glb1_expr", values_from = "score") |>
  tidyr::drop_na(`Glb1+`, `Glb1-`) |>
  mutate(diff = `Glb1+` - `Glb1-`)

paired_res <- pb_wider |>
  group_by(celltype, module, genotype) |>
  summarise(n_samples = n(),
            broom::tidy(wilcox.test(`Glb1+`, `Glb1-`, paired = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

inter_res <- pb_wider |>
  group_by(celltype, module) |>
  filter(n_distinct(genotype) == 2, min(table(genotype)) >= 3) |>
  summarise(n_samples = n(),
            broom::tidy(wilcox.test(diff ~ genotype, conf.int = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

write.csv(bind_rows(paired_res, inter_res, .id = "test"), file.path(paths$out$tables, "glb1_module_score_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
endo_cts <- c("gen_cap", "prolif gen_cap", "arterial", "aerocytes")

mm_sub <- subset(mm_seurat, subset = celltype %in% endo_cts)
mm_sub$celltype <- factor(mm_sub$celltype, levels = endo_cts)

p2 <- FeatureStatPlot(mm_sub,
  plot_type = "heatmap",
  ident = c("glb1_expr", "genotype"),
  columns_split_by = "celltype",
  features = names(gene_sets),
  palette = "RdBu",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_annotation = list(
    celltype = list(palcolor = c("aerocytes" = "#f14f7b",
                                 "arterial" = "#33658A",
                                 "gen_cap" = "#56c5cc",
                                 "prolif gen_cap" = "#f7aa1c")),
    genotype = list(palcolor = c("WT" = "#00AFBB", "KO" = "#D32F2F")),
    glb1_expr = list(palcolor = c("Glb1+" = "#2b00ff", "Glb1-" = "#7a7a7a")),
    glb1_expr_genotype = list(params = FALSE)
  )
)

ggsave(file.path(paths$out$figures, "glb1_expr_module_score_heatmap.svg"), p2, width = 12, height = 5)
```
